name: muster
description: The executive team a solo founder cannot afford to hire: six roles that show initiative, learn how you decide, and keep their own memory — with a living charter and a money invariant enforced by tool grants, so no agent can spend.

interface.shortDescription: The executive team a solo founder cannot afford to hire
interface.longDescription: Six roles with real remits and their own memory — delivery, architecture, QA, counsel, finance and brand. Each asks a standing question every run, proposes improvements nobody asked for, and learns how you decide. A chief of staff caps what reaches you at five items, and no agent can spend your money.
